sam: Cutting RC candidate 0.23.0-rc3 — ready to pin and schedule promo window at 2026-03-21T21:30:00Z. Build SHA: sha256:af3b9c4d. Need quick QA + sign-off from @jess and @tyler.

deploy-bot: Build artifact uploaded: artifact://redwood/0.23.0-rc3 (sha256:af3b9c4d). Suggested canary groups: canary-1 (5%), canary-2 (25%). Default ramp plan available.

jess: I ran migration dry-run in staging, no destructive ops. Smoke tests kicking off in qa now — should be ~8–12m. @maria can you sanity-check analytics events?

maria: Quick check done — event counts look stable. One non-blocking warning in staging logs: ```WARN analytics: missing field 'session.os'``` not seen in prod.

tyler: Oncall FYI: ran synthetic latency checks against v0.22.8 baseline. Saw one mem spike in perf run (not reproduced). I'll be on-call during the window. :thumbsup:

jess: Pinning release artifact to promo branch now. cmd: `redwood pin release --artifact sha256:af3b9c4d --env prod --note "rc3 pin for 21:30 window"`

deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged — release/0.23.0-rc3 pinned to prod-route. Next: QA thumbs or explicit 'go' for scheduled promotion.

maria: QA smoke set passed, ran prompt set + regression checks, all green. +1 from analytics.

sam: Propose staged ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds, auto-fallback to v0.22.8 on failures. Anyone object?

tyler: LGTM. Configure ramp policy: hold 10m after each step, health checks via /health and error-rate <0.5%. Auto-fallback enabled. Approving now.

jess: Release notes draft: "Fixes: hotfix for routing NPE, batching perf improvements; Notes: no prod DB migrations, analytics schema unchanged." Will publish to release docs after promo.

oncall-bot: Scheduled owner: @tyler. Pagerduty link: https://pagerduty.example/teams/infra. Reminder set 10m before window.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled for 2026-03-21T21:30:00Z. To start immediately, reply with `promo now` in this thread or wait for scheduled time. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/af3b9c4d

sam: promo now

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Rolling to canary-1 (5%). Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/release/0.23.0-rc3

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 (5%) success. time: 2026-03-21T21:31:40Z. Proceeding to step 2 -> 25%.
